recipes.NORMAL: Pressure-taper black penwork; bold focal silhouettes, distinct fine face/hand strokes and purposeful black accents.
recipes.GEKIGA: In THIS PANEL ONLY, fully redraw faces as realistic GEKIGA manga. Rebuild faces as sculptural GEKIGA: narrow eye openings, small irises partly covered by thick anatomical lids; projecting nose bridge, sidewalls and nostril wings; distinct cheekbone and jaw angles. 全人物を劇画化。顔にも写実的な陰影と斜線。背景・服だけ劇画にしない。 Primary facial shading is dense fine pen hatching and crossing strokes, retaining narrow light gaps between lines. Solid black is a secondary accent in local occlusion/contact shadows. Keep recognizable identity/age, scripted emotion, gaze, Camera/Action and body acting. BLACK AND WHITE ink on paper.
recipes.WATERCOLOR: Painterly softness through sparse broken ink contours and open white paper. Screen only inside assigned material/shadow masks; never wash or dots over lit light skin.
recipes.POP_ART: 顔/髪/服/小物/背景を極太の黒い輪郭、大胆な白黒のflat面、大粒で明瞭な規則的Ben-Day網点で印刷絵へ再構築。白肌明部は白、網点は許可された影/素材面のみ。Camera/Action・演技/表情・同一性/既定トーン・台詞/吹出配置を保持。
recipes.CHIBI_GAG: Super-deformed chibi anatomy: normally 2-3 heads tall, unless explicit proportions override. Enlarge the skull; compress torso and jointed limbs, not merely eyes. Preserve Camera/Action, body acting, individual gaze/reactions, hair/glasses. Project this redesigned body into the same shot, not a zoom or lineup. Black accents on white.
